Machine Whisper Quirk.name: Machine Whisper Quirk
Machine Whisper Quirk.description:
⚙️ You feel what a machine is doing through your hands and can talk it into doing what it was built for.

🌱 A touch tells you what is running, what is broken and how to work it; you open an electronic lock, close a shutter or stall an engine with no key or code.
📈 Training adds locking villains in their own gear, lurching a forklift at an attacker, steadying an elevator, distant drones and driverless cars, and a whole building.
⚠️ Only machines with a motor, an engine or a circuit answer: a padlock, a knife, a gun and anything living are out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as every machine you hold crowds your own thoughts until words come slowly.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Support Engineering +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Diagnostic Touch, Coaxed Lock
Machine Whisper Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: bare-skin touch reads a machine's state, faults and design and makes it run any built-in function without controls, key or code. New adult user: one touched machine at a time (car, lock, phone, drone); distance needs techniques. Limits: only motor, engine or circuit machines; never simple mechanisms (padlocks, knives, guns, bicycles) or living things, Quirk-made limbs included; implants (pacemaker, prosthetic) are beyond a new user. Only what working parts allow: no power, no motion; cut cables stay cut. No electricity, no metal pulling; many machines at once blur. Quirk Strain: light: reading, unlock, stall; moderate: locking gear, lurch, drone steering; heavy: halting a failing machine, remote driving; severe: signature, running a building. Type: Emitter. Law: unlocking or taking a vehicle without consent or license is unauthorized access and theft; police check registered machine Quirks first after a hacked door. Look: fingertips on it, eyes half shut.
